mainEntity.name: Will AI automation really save time, or will I spend weeks setting it up and fixing it?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Expect to spend time defining the process, collecting source material, configuring prompts, connecting tools, testing outputs, correcting errors, and maintaining the workflow. AI reduces some drafting and coordination effort, but it does not remove setup or review work.

Context: The Run My AI Business approach emphasizes inputs, instructions, approval checkpoints, secure connections, and ongoing refinement. Actual execution depends on the underlying AI platform and supporting services.

Key factors:
- Clarity of the existing process
- Quality of business information supplied
- Number of integrations
- Frequency of changes to tools or offers

Practical guidance: Estimate implementation and maintenance separately from subscription fees. Track how much time the assistant requires before and after each revision, and simplify the workflow when review takes longer than manual completion.

The educational materials help owners set more realistic expectations about prompt-based systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can save time, but setup includes process definition, prompt design, source preparation, integrations, testing, correction, and maintenance. Estimate those tasks separately from software costs, measure review time, and simplify or stop a workflow if it takes longer than doing the task manually.
